focus_areas: Depth consistency between subject and foreground/background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' look of the bill tip. While the colors are correct, AI often fails to render the micro-texture of keratin on bills. Also, scrutinize the white neck ring; if it bleeds into the green or chestnut without distinct feather edges, this is a strong indicator of generative blending. Ignore the missing legs as they are occluded, but ensure the visible body proportions don't imply impossible leg placement.

The duck features the characteristic iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey/brown body plumage. Its yellow bill is prominent in the foreground, showing distinct black markings (saddle and nail). The background consists of blurred vegetation and earth tones.
